title: Find the image a design replaced
responsibility: Finds a supported before-image for a design shown at the commit that introduced it.

inputs.name: priorImage.versions
inputs.description: The design versions in historical order.

inputs.name: priorImage.shown
inputs.description: The displayed version identity and optional selected image.

inputs.name: priorImage.commit
inputs.description: The selected commit, or null for a branch view.

outputs.name: priorImage
outputs.description: The prior version and image hash, or null without a selected image or matching introducing commit. Uses an explicit revised-image binding first. Without one, versions with design options are not paired; a single design falls back to the preceding version’s image with the same state and viewport.
